mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q01.stem: Compare similar-looking decorative and joining parts. What must be checked?
options: Transfer decorative acceptance to every test
Layer structure and application-specific joining requirements
reasons: Tests with different purposes cannot substitute.
Identical color can have different functions.
This does not assess joining function.
This is not the required performance.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q02.stem: A solid appears after a sample cools. What can immediately be concluded?
options: Every constituent returned to a suitable state
Formation conditions must be recorded and the analytical method checked
reasons: Deposition alone does not establish composition.
Solid appearance alone identifies neither composition nor reaction.
Even whiteness is insufficient for identification.
No electrode conditions are given.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q03.stem: Which description suits treatment with the aluminium item as anode?
options: Oxide film forms on the substrate surface
reasons: This does not describe the electrolytic method.
It does not replace a controlled process.
This confuses ordinary deposition of another metal.
This is the anodizing principle.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q04.stem: A hot-dip part has a demanding fit. What coating check is appropriate?
options: Check dimensions including outer and interfacial alloy layers
Thickness is always better when greater
Matching bath names eliminate dimensional checks
reasons: Layers and thickness affect fit.
Dimensions and function involve tradeoffs.
An approved disposition is required.
Individual requirements still need checking.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q05.stem: Replacing specified prepaint phosphate with blackening is proposed. What is appropriate?
options: Compare adhesion and other requirements with the specified process and obtain approval
Substitute immediately if colors are similar
Change only the specification's process name
reasons: Similar color does not establish interchangeability.
Roles and properties differ.
This changes requirements without approval.
This is unapproved mixing.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q06.stem: Theoretical deposit is 2.0 g and exercise efficiency 75%. What is estimated?
reasons: This divides by efficiency.
This ignores efficiency.
This incorrectly uses 75 instead of its fraction.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q07.stem: An ideal resistor carries 30 mA at 90 mV. What is its resistance?
reasons: This is current divided by voltage.
The calculation is off by a factor of 1000.
Prefix conversion is inappropriate.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q08.stem: Equipment stopping extended the wait after activation. What is the first control action?
options: Record lot, completed step, time and waiting conditions, then ask
Continue by the original schedule alone
reasons: Preserve history and obtain approved disposition.
The actual condition changed.
This hides facts.
This risks overtreatment or unclear history.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q09.stem: A nonslip mat edge lifts and creates a trip. What is appropriate?
options: Installation means there is no issue
Evaluate the new hazard and request review
reasons: Effectiveness and remaining hazards are unchecked.
This does not prove risk is absent.
The original measure can create another hazard.
This falsifies records.

mfg1-surface-mock-01-practical-q10.stem: Another process's item enters a jig shelf. What should be communicated to the next shift?
options: Only a guessed cause stated as certain
Specific numbers, locations and hold status
Move it to an empty shelf unrecorded
reasons: This does not separate facts.
Share identification and pending-confirmation information.
This makes tracing difficult.
A specified decision is required.
